Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:10:1.english: And what is the meaning of the term moseirah - That they hand it [the animal] over by means of it to the buyer.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:11:1.hebrew: אי נימא ר' מאיר - דאמר היושב בקרון סופג את הארבעים, ומתניתין יחידאה היא, ולית הלכתא כוותיה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:11:1.english: If we say [it is] Rabbi Meir - who said [that] one who sits in a wagon receives the forty [lashes], and [then] our Mishnah is an individual opinion, and the halakhah is not in accordance with him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:11:2.hebrew: השתא לר"מ יושב קני - דקאמר היושב בקרון סופג את הארבעים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:11:2.english: Now, according to Rabbi Meir, one who sits acquires [it] - For he says: One who sits in a wagon incurs the forty [lashes].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:11:3.english: Is [the case of] one who rides necessary [to state] - And why do I need [the Tanna] to teach us in both [cases]?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:11:4.hebrew: אלא לאו רבנן - ואשמועינן דביושב הוא דפטור, אבל רכוב לא; ותיובתא לרב יהודה, דפשט רוכב מיושב:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:11:4.english: Rather, is it not [the opinion of] the Rabbis - And [the Mishnah] teaches us that it is [only] with regard to one who sits [in a wagon] that [he] is exempt, whereas one who rides is not [exempt, i.e., he acquires]; and [this is] a refutation of Rav Yehuda, who resolved [the law of] one who rides from [that of] one who sits.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:12:1.hebrew: במנהיג ברגליו - דקנייה במשיכה, שבועט בה ברגליו והולכת מחמתו כדרך רוכבי סוסים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:12:1.english: With one who leads [it] with his legs - For he acquires it through pulling [meshikhah], as he kicks it with his legs and it walks because of him, in the manner of horse riders.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:12:2.hebrew: היינו מנהיג - והו"ל למיתני, או שהיו שניהם מנהיגים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:12:2.english: This is [the same as] leading - And [the Tanna] should have taught: "or if both of them were leading [it]."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:12:3.hebrew: תרי גווני מנהיג - דאי אשמועינן בשני מנהיגים דיחלוקו, לא היינו יודעים להאי מהו דתימא כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:12:3.english: Two types of leading - For if [the Mishnah] had taught us regarding two [people] leading [an animal] that they divide [it], we would not have known this "lest you say," etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:13:1.hebrew: חמור דרכו בהנהגה, וגמל דרכו במשיכה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:13:1.english: A donkey — its [usual] way is by driving, and a camel — its [usual] way is by pulling.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:1:1.hebrew: שמעית מיניה דמר שמואל תרתי - שמעתי ממנו שני דברים: דין רכוב ודין מנהיג. בחד אמר לי קני, ובחד אמר לי לא קני, ולא ידענא כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:1:1.english: I heard two [things] from Master Shmuel - I heard from him two matters: the law of one who rides [an animal] and the law of one who leads [an animal]. Regarding one he told me he acquires [it], and regarding one he told me he does not acquire [it], and I do not know, etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:2:1.hebrew: אי נימא רכוב לחודיה - שאין אחר מנהיג עמו, ובא אחד מן השוק וחוטפו ממנו בפנינו ומושכה לקנותה. וכן מנהיג ואין רכוב עמו, ובא אחד וחוטפו ממנו בפנינו לקנותה. וקאמר שמואל בחד מינייהו דלא קני, ומאן דחטף שפיר חטף, ומבעיא ליה לרב יהודה בהי מינייהו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:2:1.english: If we say [it refers to] one riding alone - where there is no one else leading [the animal] with him, and someone comes from the marketplace and snatches it from him in our presence and pulls it to acquire it. And similarly, [one who is] leading [an animal] with no rider with him, and someone comes and snatches it from him in our presence to acquire it. And Shmuel says regarding one of them that he did not acquire [it], and the one who snatched [it] validly snatched [it], and Rav Yehuda was uncertain regarding which of them [this was said].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:2:2.hebrew: מנהיג לחודיה מי איכא למאן דאמר דלא קני - הא משיכה היא זו, ובהמה נקנית במשיכה. ומאי תיבעי ליה לרב יהודה? אי ודאי אמר שמואל בחד מינייהו דלא קני, ברכוב הוא דקאמר, דקסבר משיכה בעינן שתעקור יד ורגל, כדאמרינן בקדושין (דף כב:):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:2:2.english: One who leads alone — is there anyone who says that [he] does not acquire? - Surely this is pulling [meshikhah], and an animal is acquired through pulling. So why was Rav Yehudah uncertain? If Shmuel certainly said regarding one of them that he does not acquire, it is regarding the rider that he said [it], for he holds [that for] pulling we require that [the animal] lift a foreleg and a hindleg, as we say in Kiddushin (22b).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:3:1.hebrew: אלא רכוב במקום מנהיג - שניהם באים לפנינו, זה רכוב וזה מנהיג, זה אומר כולה שלי וזה אומר כולה שלי. אמר שמואל חד קני, ומבעיא ליה לרב יהודה: היכא דאיתנהו לתרוייהו, הי עדיף? רכוב עדיף דהא תפיס בה, וכי אמרינן משיכה קני — היכא דליכא רכוב, אבל במקום רכוב לא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:3:1.english: Rather, [one] riding where [another is] leading - Both of them come before us, this one riding and that one leading; this one says, "All of it is mine," and that one says, "All of it is mine." Shmuel said [that] one [of them] acquires [it], and Rav Yehuda asks: Where both of them are present, which [method of acquisition] is preferable? Is [the one] riding preferable, since he is grasping it, and when we say [that] pulling acquires — [that is] where there is no rider, but in the presence of a rider, [it does] not [acquire]?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:3:2.english: Or perhaps [the one] leading [it] is preferable, as it walks because of him - And that is the greater [factor] in acquisition.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:4:1.hebrew: למאן אי לר' מאיר כו' עד לרבנן - לא גרס:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:4:1.english: According to whom? If according to Rabbi Meir, etc., up to “according to the Rabbis” - [We] do not have this reading.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:4:2.hebrew: נחזי אנן - אית לן למפשט משמעתא דמר שמואל, בהי מינייהו אמר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:4:2.english: Let us see ourselves - We can resolve [it] from the teaching of Mar Shmuel, regarding which of them he said [it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:4:3.english: The one leading - With an ox and a donkey.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:4:4.english: Deems exempt - He holds [that] he does not do anything.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:5:1.hebrew: ומדאפיך שמואל כו' - ש"מ סבירא לשמואל רכוב לאו מידי מעשה עביד, ומשום דיחיד ורבים הלכה כרבים, אפכה למתניתין לאוקמא פטורא כרבנן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:5:1.english: And from [the fact] that Shmuel reversed, etc. - Conclude from it [that] Shmuel holds [that] one who rides does not perform any action, and because [in a dispute between] an individual and the majority the halakha is in accordance with the majority, he reversed the Mishnah to establish the exemption in accordance with the Rabbis.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:5:2.hebrew: הכי גרסינן שמע מינה ס"ל לשמואל רכוב לחודיה לא קני - ולא גרס לרבנן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:5:2.english: This is how we read [the text]: Conclude from it [that] Shmuel holds [that] one who rides alone does not acquire - and it does not read "according to the Rabbis."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:6:1.english: And many times you said - [regarding] this teaching: "Let us see [for] ourselves."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:6:2.english: And you did not say to us - Rather, [you said it] in your own name to resolve Rav Yehuda's uncertainty.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:7:1.hebrew: אברא - אמת הוא, אמר לי "נחזי אנן", וזכור אני שאמרתי לו: היכי תפשוט מר רכוב מיושב בקרון:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:7:1.english: Indeed [ivra] - It is true [that] he said to me, "Let us see," and I remember that I said to him, "How can the Master resolve [the case of] one riding from [the case of] one sitting in a wagon?"

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:7:3.hebrew: מוסירה אינה קונה - במציאה, עד שיוליכנה ותעקור יד ורגל. ואף על גב דבמכירה קני, כדתנן (קדושין דף כה:) בהמה גסה נקנית במסירה, לגבי מציאה לא קני, כדאמרינן טעמא לקמן בשמעתין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:7:3.english: [Holding] the reins does not acquire - [In the case of] a found object, [it does not acquire] until he leads it and it lifts a foreleg and a hindleg. And even though in a sale it does acquire — as we learned in the Mishnah (Kiddushin 25b): "Large livestock is acquired through handing over [the reins]" — regarding a found object it does not acquire, as we state the reason below in our discussion.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:8:1.hebrew: איכא דאמרי - רב יוסף משמיה דנפשיה קאמר: נחזי אנן, וא"ל אביי: היכי תפשוט רכוב כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:8:1.english: There are those who say - Rav Yosef stated it on his own authority: "Let us see [and reason it out]," and Abaye said to him: "How can you resolve [the case of] one riding, etc.?"

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:8:2.english: Idi - The name of a Sage.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:9:1.english: From another - [In a case of] buying and selling.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:9:2.hebrew: בנכסי הגר - שמת ואין לו יורשין, וכל הקודם בנכסיו זכה בהן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8b:9:2.english: [With regard to] the property of a convert - Who died and has no heirs, and whoever is first [to take possession] of his property acquires it.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8b:12:1.hebrew: מהו דתימא רכוב עדיף - פי': חזקתו עדיף, ויבטל את חזקת המנהיג; קמ"ל דשניהם מוחזקים ויחלוקו. אבל אין לפרש: "מהו דתימא דרכוב עדיף ויבטל את קנין המנהיג, קמ"ל דשניהם קנו", כדפרישית לעיל, דאפילו לא הוי קני במקום רכוב, מקרי מוחזק, כיון דמנהיג לחודיה קני. וא"ת: לעיל כי פריך "השתא יושב קני, רכוב מיבעיא", לישני דקא משמע לן דלא מבטל חזקת רכוב דתפיס בה ואזלא מחמתיה את חזקת המנהיג? וי"ל דאין צריך להשמיענו, דפשיטא דרכוב לחודיה בלא מנהיג ברגליו לא חשיב לבטל את חזקת המנהיג, דאי משום דתפיס בה, מנהיג נמי אזלא מחמתיה טפי מרכוב. אבל השתא דמיירי במנהיג ברגליו, דכיון דכל מה שיש במנהיג יש ברכוב, ועוד דתפיס בה, יבטל את חזקת המנהיג — קא משמע לן. ולפי מאי דאוקימנא השתא במנהיג ברגליו, אתיא כרבנן, וכל שכן כרבי מאיר:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8b:12:1.english: Lest you say that one who is riding takes precedence - Explanation: his possession is stronger and would nullify the possession of the one leading; [therefore, the Gemara] teaches us that both are in possession and they divide [the animal]. However, one should not explain [the Gemara to mean]: "Lest you say that one who is riding takes precedence and would nullify the acquisition of the one leading, [therefore] it teaches us that both acquired [it]," as I explained above, for even if [the one leading] did not acquire alongside one who is riding, he is [still] called in possession, since leading alone acquires. And if you ask: above, when [the Gemara] asked, "Now [that we say] one who is sitting acquires, is there any need [to state] one who is riding?", let it answer that it teaches us that the possession of one who is riding — who holds it and it goes on account of him — does not nullify the possession of the one leading? And one can answer that it is unnecessary to teach us [this], for it is obvious that riding alone without leading with his legs is not significant [enough] to nullify the possession of the one leading; for if [it were] because he holds it, [with] the one leading too, it goes on account of him even more than [on account of] the rider. However, now that [the Gemara] is dealing with one who leads with his legs, since everything that is in the one leading is [also] in the one riding, and furthermore that he holds it, [one might think] he nullifies the possession of the one leading — [therefore] it teaches us [otherwise]. And according to what we have now established — [that it deals] with one who leads with his legs — it follows [even] according to the Rabbis, and all the more so according to Rabbi Meir.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8b:2:1.hebrew: מנהיג לחודיה מי איכא מאן דאמר לא קנה - אע"ג דלר"ש אית ליה בפ"ק דקדושין (דף כה: ושם) דבהמה [בין דקה בין גסה] אינה נקנית אלא בהגבהה, מ"מ פריך מכח סתם מתניתין, דהא תנן: "אחד רכוב ואחד מנהיג כו'". והא דתנן בפ"ק דקדושין (שם): "בהמה גסה נקנית במסירה, דברי ר"מ ור"א" — "אף במסירה" קאמר, וכ"ש במשיכה; וכן התם בגמ', דהיכא דמזכיר "מסירה" הוי פי' "אף במסירה", ובמקום שמזכיר "משיכה" — דוקא, ולא מסירה. ובלאו הכי צריך לומר כן התם:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8b:2:1.english: [As for one] who leads alone, is there anyone who says he does not acquire [it]? - Even though Rabbi Shimon holds in the first chapter of Kiddushin (25b and there) that an animal [whether small or large] is acquired only through lifting (hagbahah), nevertheless [the Gemara] asks from the force of the anonymous Mishnah [here], for we learned: "One riding and one leading, etc." And [as for] that which we learned in the first chapter of Kiddushin (ibid.): "A large animal is acquired through handing over (mesirah), the words of Rabbi Meir and Rabbi Eliezer" — it means "even through mesirah," and all the more so through pulling (meshikhah); and likewise there in the Gemara, wherever it mentions "mesirah," the meaning is "even through mesirah," and in the place where it mentions "meshikhah" — [it means] specifically [meshikhah], and not mesirah. And even without this, it is necessary to say so there.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8b:2:2.hebrew: רכוב הוא דלא קני - ומתני' דאחד רכוב, דחי לקמן במנהיג ברגליו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8b:2:2.english: [It is] the rider who does not acquire - And [as for] the Mishnah [that speaks] of "one riding," [the Gemara] deflects [the proof from it] later [by explaining it as referring] to one who drives [the animal] with his feet.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8b:3:1.hebrew: רכוב עדיף דתפיס בה - אין לפרש דתפיס ברגליו או במה שיושב עליה, דהאי לא מיקרי תפיס בה, אלא במה שהוא תפוס במוסירה קרי תפיס בה, דהא בסמוך נקט האי לישנא. וצריך לומר דתפיס בה ואזלא נמי מעט מחמתיה, או דלמא מנהיג עדיף דאזלא מחמתיה טובא; דאי לא מיבעיא ליה ברכוב אלא משום דתפיס בה גרידא, א"כ מה פושט בסמוך מיושב דפטור והכי נמי דרכוב לא קני? והלא לענין כלאים אינו תלוי כלל בתפיסה אלא באזלא מחמתיה, ולענין קנין אינו תלוי כי אם בתפיס בה ולא באזלא מחמתיה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8b:3:1.english: The rider takes precedence, as he holds it - One should not explain [this to mean] that he holds [the animal] with his legs or by sitting upon it, for that is not called "holding it"; rather, [the Gemara] calls "holding it" [the case] where he is holding the reins, for shortly below it uses this expression. And it is necessary to say [that the Gemara's dilemma is a case] where he holds it and it also walks somewhat because of him, or perhaps the one leading [it] takes precedence because it walks a great deal because of him. For if his dilemma regarding the rider were only because he holds it alone, if so, how does [the Gemara] resolve [the dilemma] shortly below from [the case of] one sitting [in a wagon], that he is exempt [from lashes], and similarly that the rider does not acquire [the animal]? Is it not [the case] that with respect to kilayim [diverse kinds], it does not depend at all on holding [the reins], but rather on [whether] it walks because of him, whereas with respect to acquisition, it depends only on [whether] he holds it and not on [whether] it walks because of him?

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8b:3:2.hebrew: או דלמא מנהיג עדיף כו' - תימה, דלפשוט ממתני' דמנהיג קונה במקום רכוב! ואי רכוב איירי במנהיג ברגליו, כ"ש דמנהיג עדיף — דאפילו במקום רכוב ומנהיג ברגליו קני, כ"ש במקום רכוב לחודיה! וי"ל, דמן המשנה אין להוכיח דקני מנהיג במקום רכוב, דאפילו לא קני מיקרי מוחזק; דכיון דמנהיג לחודיה, שלא במקום רכוב, קני — מקרי מוחזק אפי' במקום רכוב. ומ"מ לקמן מוכיח שפיר ממתניתין דרכוב לחודיה קני, מאחר שקרוי מוחזק — דאי אפילו לחודיה לא קני, סברא הוא דאפי' מוחזק נמי לא הוי. וכן לעיל דקאמר: "אילימא מהא, 'שנים אוחזין' — האי אמר: 'כולה אגבהתי'', אבל שנים שהגביהו לא קנו" — התם נמי, אע"ג דכמו שהם שניהם תפוסים לא קנו, מקרי מוחזק; כיון דאם היה מגביה לחודיה, אילו לא היה חבירו תפוס בצד השני, היה קונה — לכך איקרי מוחזק אפילו עם חבירו. ומסיפא אין להוכיח דרכוב ומנהיג קנו שניהם זה במקום זה, דקתני: "אם היו שניהם מודים יחלוקו" — דאין שניהם מודים שכך קנו אותה ביחד, זה ברכיבה וזה בהנהגה, אלא שניהם בהנהגה או בקנין אחר:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8b:3:2.english: Or perhaps [the one] leading [takes] precedence, etc. - This is astonishing! Let [the Gemara] resolve [the dilemma] from the Mishnah, [which indicates] that one who leads acquires [the animal] in place of one who rides [it]! And if "riding" refers to one who leads [it] with his feet, all the more so does one who leads take precedence — for if he acquires even in place of one who rides and leads with his feet, all the more so [does he acquire] in place of one who rides alone! And one can answer that from the Mishnah there is no proof that one who leads acquires in place of one who rides, for even if he does not acquire [it], he is called muchzak [in possession]; since one who leads alone, not in place of one who rides, acquires [it], he is called muchzak even in place of one who rides. Nevertheless, later [the Gemara] proves well from our Mishnah that one who rides alone acquires [it], since he is called muchzak — for if even alone he did not acquire [it], it stands to reason that he would not even be considered muchzak. And similarly above, where [the Gemara] says: "If we say from this [Mishnah], 'Two are holding [a garment]' — this one says, 'I lifted all of it,' [implying that] two who lifted [it] did not acquire [it]" — there too, even though as they are both holding it they did not acquire [it], [each] is called muchzak; since if he had lifted [it] alone, had his fellow not been holding the other side, he would have acquired [it], therefore he is called muchzak even with his fellow. And from the latter clause [of the Mishnah] there is no proof that one who rides and one who leads both acquire one in place of the other, where it teaches, "If both of them admit, they divide [it]" — for they are not both admitting that they acquired it together in this manner, this one by riding and that one by leading, rather both [acquired it] by leading or by another act of acquisition.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8b:5:1.hebrew: רכוב לחודיה לא קני - נראה דרב יהודה היה מסופק: אם שמע משמואל ברכוב לחודיה ומנהיג לחודיה, ואז פשיט ליה דרכוב הוא דלא קני; או אם שמיע ליה ברכוב במקום מנהיג, ואז מספקא ליה הי מינייהו קני. דאי לא מספקא ליה, אלא שמע משמואל ברכוב במקום מנהיג ותו לא — א"כ ס"ל לשמואל דרכוב לחודיה קני, והשתא פשיט רב יהודה דאפילו לחודיה לא קני:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8b:5:1.english: A rider alone does not acquire - It appears that Rav Yehudah was in doubt: whether he heard from Shmuel regarding a rider alone and a leader alone, and then it is obvious to him that the rider is the one who does not acquire; or whether he heard from him regarding a rider in the presence of a leader, and then he is in doubt which of them acquires. For if he were not in doubt, but rather heard from Shmuel regarding a rider in the presence of a leader and nothing more — if so, Shmuel holds that a rider alone acquires, and now Rav Yehudah resolves that even [a rider] alone does not acquire:
